name: Ninomiya Ibuki
source:
With the onset of vampiric symptoms, Ibuki turned into a Vampdoll and was conscripted into the Army. There, she showed herself to be gifted with the blade, amassing an impressive kill count while she was still a fresh recruit. Her marksmanship, however, is nothing much to write home about.

She's beautiful, but straight-laced to a fault. Being bad with all things romantic, she tries to avoid sucking blood due to the accompanying arousal. This leaves her feeling peckish most of the time.

Ibuki feels indebted towards her childhood friend Ao, who became her bride thorn. She tends to run her mouth about 'protecting her' as a result.

[Translated from [url=https://vampdoll.dojin.com/character/]the official description[/url]. Official translation can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3000960/__The_Novel_Game/?beta=1]on Steam.[/url]]
